svg.title: Scoreboard: MUÑOZ REY, DAVID
svg.desc: Scoreboard for MUÑOZ REY, DAVID. Founder-engineer: strategy, product and code, judged by what ships. Six attempts, each judged by three lamps: shipped, tested, public. Two white lamps make a good lift; fewer reads pending, not failed. AEP Tarima: Referee operations, Spanish powerlifting (1,233 tests). Shipped, tested, public source; good lift. Trazum: Open-source AI spend analysis (npm 2.7.7). Shipped, tested, public source; good lift. Propel: AI-native CRM for outbound sales (propeltech.io). Shipped, tested, private source; good lift. Axis: ECG decision-support copilot (12-lead ECG). Not shipped yet, tested, public source; good lift. Zolts: GTM operating system (10 blueprints). Not shipped yet, tested, public source; good lift. Atesta: Audit readiness for ENS and NIS2 (ENS + NIS2). Not shipped yet, tested, private source; pending.
